evidence: Here we report a PEALD process for the deposition of TaN on Si substrates at 400 ° C using isopropylimido(triethylmethylamido)tantalum as the tantalum precursor. An Ar/N2/H2 gas mixture was flowed upstream of an Advanced Energy LB1501 remote inductively coupled plasma source. The Ar/N2/H2 gas mixture served a dual role as the purge gas, efficiently removing residual precursors and by-products of the ALD reaction.
